data.summary: Beispielgrid Energy GmbH sent Harriet Collins the annual electricity statement for 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026, showing usage of 2,418 kWh and a balance due of €184.36 after instalments, with a new monthly instalment of €94.00 starting in December.
data.explanation: Your electricity provider used more energy than your instalments covered, leaving a balance of €184.36 to pay by the deadline shown (14 days after the statement date). From December your monthly instalment rises to €94.00. Pay the balance by bank transfer to the IBAN shown, using your account number as reference. If you don't pay in time, the provider may send a reminder or charge late fees, though none are stated here. If the new instalment seems too high compared to your actual usage, you can contact the provider to ask for an adjustment.
